annotation.title_en: Civil Aeronautics Act (Aviation Act) of Japan
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Government of Japan (Diet; Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's Civil Aeronautics Act (1952, as amended to 2025) regulates aircraft registration, airworthiness, crew licensing, airports, air transport businesses, security, decarbonisation, and, in Chapter 11, unmanned aircraft (drones): registration, airframe and type certification, pilot licensing, registered inspection bodies, and flight rules.
key_provisions_or_claims: Unmanned aircraft must be registered and carry identification before flight (Arts. 132-132-12).
Airframe certification (Class 1/2) and type certification against safety and uniformity standards for drones (Arts. 132-13 to 132-23).
Remote pilot licences (first/second class) with exams, medical checks, 3-year validity and renewal courses.
Registered inspection bodies, exam bodies and training bodies supervised by the MLIT minister.
Penalties and orders for non-compliance; manned aircraft airworthiness, crew, airport and air transport rules.
